images.title: Total minus known gives the missing value
images.purpose: Shows the core move of the practice: mean times count gives the total, and the total minus the known values gives the missing value.
images.composition: Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, no scenery, no characters, no extra text. One long horizontal bar in the centre, split into a long part and a short part, with a bracket over the whole bar.
images.exact_structure: One horizontal bar about two thirds of the frame wide, split into two parts. The left part, about 84 percent of the length, is filled teal (#0072B2) with the label known values 70 inside it. The right part, about 16 percent, is filled amber (#E69F00) with the label y = 13 inside it. Above the whole bar a reddish purple (#CC79A7) bracket spans both parts with the label total 10.375 × 8 = 83 above it. Under the bar, centred, the line 83 − 70 = 13. Nothing else.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Find the total from the mean, then take away what you know.
images.description: Shows the core move of the practice: mean times count gives the total, and the total minus the known values gives the missing value.
images.context: FiO1.q7: 8, 13, 10, 4, 5, 20, y, 10 with mean 10.375. Total 83, known sum 70, y = 13.
images.teaching_notes: Same move solves the kushti and coconut questions.

image_decisions.why: A single bar split into known and missing parts pictures the one move behind every missing value question.
